races.paceDynamic: Station X stands as the sole confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead in the early stages, setting a sustainable gallop. Behind him, Sports Coach, Master Of My Fate, Reigning Profit, Mon Na Slieve and Kinetic Force will all vie for prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems when the field bunches turning for home over this sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Station X Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Station X gets clear early and the prominent pack get tangled up behind
scenarios.body: The leader builds a crucial 2-length advantage while the chasers impede each other. His recent consistency at 6f suggests he can stay strong enough to repel late challengers over this shorter trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly strong with prominent runners scrapping for position
scenarios.body: The early skirmishing sets up perfectly for the back-markers to sweep through in the final furlong. Tiriac's recent winning form and Havana Blast's class give them the finishing kick needed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sports Coach or Master Of My Fate can secure the ideal tracking position behind Station X
scenarios.body: One of the in-form prominent runners gets first run on the leader and sustains their challenge. The pace becomes genuine but not suicidal, suiting horses who can travel and quicken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the field remains tightly bunched turning for home with no clear pace advantage
scenarios.body: The sprint becomes a lottery with horses getting hampered and others finding gaps at crucial moments. Form goes out the window as track position and racing luck determine the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Station X could steal this if he gets 3+ lengths clear early as the prominent pack will struggle to make up ground over 5f
Sports Coach and Master Of My Fate both need the going to remain on the easy side to reproduce their best form
Traffic problems are almost inevitable 2f out with six horses wanting prominent positions behind the lone leader
Tiriac's recent winning run has come from hold-up tactics and he'll need a strong pace to be effective
Havana Blast carries a going-dependent warning but has solid form figures when conditions suit
